arabic text:
KARNAY KO DUA RAB SAY,
MEIN HATH UTHATI HOUN,
AMEEN KAHO BACHO,
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
I AM RAISING MY HANDS
TO SAY A PRAYER TO GOD
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN.
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text: DARYA SAY ABHI APNAY, AMMU KO BULAATI HUN\nAMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text: I WILL CALL MY UNCLE BACK FROM THE RIVER NOW O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
DARYA SE ABHI APNE, AMMU KO BULAATI HOON
AMEEN KAHO BACHO, KARNE KO DUA RAB SE,
MEIN HAATH UTHAATI HOON, AMEEN KAHO BACHO,
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
I AM RAISING MY HANDS
I WILL CALL MY UNCLE BACK FROM THE RIVER NOW O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN
TO SAY A PRAYER TO GOD
PLEASE, O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN.

arabic text:
KHAIMON MEI TARAAYI KO, LAANE KA IRAADA HAI,
ABBAS KA WAADA HAI
WAADA WOH NIBHAENGAY, MEIN TUMKO BATAATI HUN
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
HE WANTS TO BRING THE WATER TO OUR TENTS
ABBAS HAS PROMISED
I KNOW HE KEEPS HIS PROMISE,
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
WHO PYAAS KA AALAM HAI, LAB KHOLA NAHI JATA,
KUCH BOLA NAHI JAATA
MEIN HARFE DUA APNE ASHKON KO BANAATI HUN
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
SUCH IS OUR THIRST, WE CANNOT OPEN OUR PARCHED LIPS,
I AM UNABLE TO SPEAK,
I HAVE TURNED MY TEARS INTO MY SUPPLICATION
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
PAANI JO MEIN KISMAT SAY, THORA SA BHI PAAUNGI
ASGHAR KO PILAAUNGI
BAS EK DUA LAB PAR, RORO KAY MEIN LAATI HUN
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
EVEN IF I FIND A LITTLE BIT OF WATER,
I WILL GIVE IT TO ASGHAR TO DRINK,
MY EYES FILLED WITH TEARS, THIS IS MY ONLY SUPPLICATION,
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
AAHAT HAI BALAA KISKI, MEIN DEKH KE AATI HOON
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
SHAANE PAY ALAM HOGA
AI BACHON YAQINAN WHO, AMU KA KADAM HOGA,
english translation text: O CHILDREN I AM SURE MY UNCLE IS COMING WITH THE FLAG ON HIS SHOULDERS\nLET ME FIND OUT WHOSE FOOTSTEPS I HEAR\nO CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
MEI CHAIN NA PAAUNGI, AMMU SE JUDAA HOKAR,
MARJAAUNGI RORO KAR
ALLAH MEIN TUJHE APNI, FARYAAD SUNAATI HUN
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
I WILL REMAIN RESTLESS AFTER BEING SEPARATED FROM MY UNCLE
I SHALL DIE WEEPING,
O ALLAH! PLEASE HEAR MY LAMENTATION
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
DETI HUN SADA ROKAR
AMMU HAI MUSIBAT MEIN, DADI KO BULAATI HUN
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
WHO UTH KAY MADINAY SAY, AAJAAENGI DARYA PAR,
english translation text:
SHE (BIBI FATIMA) WILL COME TO THE RIVER (FURAT) FROM MADINA,
I SHALL CRY OUT TO HER,
MY UNCLE IS IN DIFFICULTY, I WILL CALL MY GRANDMOTHER
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text:
SHABBIR KAY KHAYME MEIN, NAYYAR HAI BAPA MATAM,
AATI HAI SADA MESUM
PYAASI HU SAKINA HOON, ROTI HOON RULAATI HOON
AMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text:
IN THE CAMP OF SHABBIR (A.S), THERE IS LAMENTATION,
THE SOUND OF WEEPING CAN BE HEARD,
I AM SAKINA, I AM THIRSTY, I AM CRYING WITH EVERYONE ELSE AROUND ME,
O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN

arabic text: DARYA SAY ABHI APNAY, AMMU KO BULAATI HUN\nAMEEN KAHO BACHO
english translation text: I WILL CALL MY UNCLE BACK FROM THE RIVER NOW,\nPLEASE, O CHILDREN, SAY AAMEEN
